[
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Las = Spanish plural definite article 'the'; Vegas = plural of vega, from Iberian/Romance 'vega' = fertile plain, meadow; attested in Spanish dictionaries",
    "reading": "The fertile plains — a place of watered lowlands, not desert",
    "languages": ["es", "la"],
    "source": "Real Academia Española, Diccionario de la lengua española, s.v. 'vega'",
    "confidence": 0.9
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "Las + Vegas; 'las' = la(s) = 'the' (fr) + 'vegas' → 'végas' (fr) = 'sails' (vogues) or 'vagues' (waves); sound: /lɑs veɪɡəs/",
    "reading": "The waves that sail — a mirage of motion in stillness",
    "languages": ["en", "fr", "es"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "Las Vegas → 'laisse vagues' (fr) = 'let waves'; also 'la(s) vegas' → 'la vega' (it) = 'the vein' (in mining)",
    "reading": "Let the waves be — or the vein of ore hidden beneath the plain",
    "languages": ["fr", "it", "es"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "Las Vegas → 'salgaves' → 'sal' (salt) + 'gaves' (fr) = 'rivers' (Garonne tributaries); also 'vases glas' (fr) = 'green vases'",
    "reading": "Salt rivers and green vessels — a land of brine and verdure",
    "languages": ["fr", "la", "es"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "notariqon",
    "chain": "L.V. → Latin 'locus viridis' = green place; also 'lumen veritatis' = light of truth; initials as acrostic",
    "reading": "Green locus or light of truth — a double‑tongued sign",
    "languages": ["la", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "L = 50 (Roman), V = 5, S = 7 (Greek stigma); 'Las Vegas' → L‑V‑S → 50‑5‑7; also 'V' = feminine, 'S' = serpent",
    "reading": "Fifty, five, seven — a numeric triad; V as vessel, S as winding path",
    "languages": ["la", "grc", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "numerical",
    "chain": "Gematria (Hebrew): Lamed=30, Shin=300, Vav=6, Gimel=3, Samekh=60 → 30+300+6+3+60 = 399; also 'Las Vegas' in simple A1Z26: L=12, A=1, S=19, V=22, E=5, G=7, A=1, S=19 → sum = 86",
    "reading": "399 (Hebrew) — a number of completion; 86 (Latin) — a hidden cipher of 'the plain'",
    "languages": ["he", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.2
  },
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Vega from Arabic 'baq'a' (بقعة) = 'patch of ground', via Mozarabic; 'las' from Latin 'illas' (those)",
    "reading": "Those patches of ground — a plural of scattered oases",
    "languages": ["ar", "la", "es"],
    "source": "Corriente, Dictionary of Arabic and Allied Loanwords (Spanish), s.v. 'vega'",
    "confidence": 0.7
  }
]
